intro.zh: 本次版本更新带来更稳定、流畅的陪伴。公告也可以随时在设置的更新区域查看。
intro.en: This update makes your companion more stable and responsive. You can revisit these notes anytime in Settings under Updates.

items.zh: 修复 Windows 切换或关闭窗口时可能出现的闪退。
items.en: Fixed Windows crashes when switching or closing windows.

items.zh: 静止气泡减少重复重绘，让陪伴更轻盈。
items.en: Stationary bubbles redraw less often for a lighter experience.

items.zh: 内置规则先识别对象再分类，改善英文软件识别。
items.en: Built-in rules identify the subject before classifying it, with better recognition of English app names.

items.zh: 规则说明不再被过短上限截断，英文匹配词也更准确。
items.en: Rule descriptions are no longer cut short, and English matching terms are more accurate.
